title: Perfect Unity
story:
A young boy once watched a broken mirror lying on the ground.

It had fallen and shattered into many pieces.

Each piece showed only a part of the reflection.

Some pieces were small.

Some were unclear.

The boy tried to see his full reflection but could not.

Later, his father carefully collected all the pieces.

He repaired and joined them together.

Slowly, the mirror became whole again.

Now the reflection was complete and clear.

His father said,

“Separated pieces cannot show the full picture.”

“But when they are united, everything becomes clear.”

In life, division creates confusion.

Separation brings brokenness.

But in God, we are made one.

His love brings completeness.

And through Christ, we are united with the Father.
life_lesson: True unity and completeness are found in God’s love through Christ.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for uniting me with You through Jesus.

Help me to live in love and unity with others.

Remove division from my heart.

Make me complete in Your love.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Are there areas of brokenness or division in your life?

How does God’s love bring unity and healing?

How can you live in greater unity with God and others today?
verse:
I in them and You in Me—so that they may be brought to complete unity.
Then the world will know that You sent Me and have loved them even as You have loved Me.
